localEquivalence.result: the xai API-key voice path is not an equivalent: auth mode, token-auth header and client identity differ and the OAuth connection pool never reaches it. The grok-cli OAuth voice path is missing, so this module is the whole delta

exports.grokCliTtsAdapter: default TTS adapter instance; synthesize(text, model, credentials, responseFormat, options) -> { base64, format, accounting } or error result
exports.grokCliSttAdapter: default STT adapter instance; transcribe({ model, formData, credentials, kind, signal })
exports.buildGrokSpeechRequest: (model, text, options) -> source JSON body; throws a 400 error
exports.buildGrokTranscriptionRequest: async (model, formData, { kind }) -> { body: FormData, responseFormat } or a 400 error result with local: true
exports.matchesGrokCodec: (codec, bytes) -> boolean (mp3/wav magic bytes, headerless codecs non-empty)
exports.grokOAuthToken: (credentials, now?) -> { token } or { failure } (OAuth access token only, expiry checked)
exports.grokRefusal: (status, { modality, label, secrets, retryAfter }) refusal mapping that never quotes the upstream
exports.grokAcceptedJob: (modality, jobState) accepted-job accounting with unknown cost
exports.grokVoiceHeaders: (token) -> source grokMediaHeaders with the fork's pinned Grok CLI identity
exports.GROK_CLI_TTS_CONFIG: staged ttsConfig for the existing grok-cli registry entry
exports.GROK_CLI_STT_CONFIG: staged sttConfig for the existing grok-cli registry entry
exports.GROK_STT_OPTION_FIELDS: source native options in source order

auth.apiKeySubstitution: refused: an apiKey-only connection gets 401 unsent, as in the source; the xai API-key provider stays a separate mode
auth.refresh: not done in the adapter; the route refreshes the selected connection before dispatch. An expired or unparseable expiresAt is a 401 before any send

models.passthrough: refused: the registry's passthroughModels covers chat; voice takes only the listed ids
models.dynamicDiscovery: none: the source lists Grok voice models statically; the registry modelsUrl (cli-chat-proxy /v1/models) feeds chat models and is not a voice contract

speech.body: { text, voice_id, language, output_format: { codec, sample_rate?, bit_rate? }, speed? }
speech.answer: audio bytes in the requested codec

transcription.body: multipart: model, [language, diarize, multichannel, channels, sample_rate, audio_format, format, filler_words], file (last)
transcription.answer: JSON object with string text (duration, words kept); text format returns text/plain
